name: Product Form
summary: Native product-purchase form that composes canonical option, quantity, and primary-action controls while targets own merchandise resolution and the purchase lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native product-purchase form and form-associated control boundary on Web.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned feedback placement; the target owns its text, tone, role, announcement, focus, and lifecycle.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Intrinsic action row containing the purchase submitter.

anatomy.name: submit
anatomy.description: Canonical primary Button used as the explicit native submitter.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic size that wraps from its container capacity.

states.name: withSelection
states.description: Both reviewed selection dependencies are present.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: The resolved selection cannot currently be purchased and the native submitter is disabled without a target pending lifecycle.

states.name: pending
states.description: Target purchase work is pending; canonical Button busy treatment blocks repeat activation and preserves the label.

states.name: withFeedback
states.description: Target-owned purchase feedback is present in the form flow.

behavior.name: nativePurchaseForm
behavior.description: The real form and its complete FormData remain functional without JavaScript. Named controls, activated submitter, successful-entry construction, constraint validation and reset stay native.

behavior.name: dependencyComposition
behavior.description: Product Form consumes canonical Variant Selector, Quantity Selector and Button markup without replacing their value, keyboard, validation or visual ownership.

behavior.name: resolvedPurchaseData
behavior.description: The shared product coordinator maps current options to one purchasable identifier and synchronizes availability and quantity rules before enabling or submitting; Product Form consumes that state and owns no mirrored object or variant database.

behavior.name: submitAction
behavior.description: One canonical Button is the explicit submitter. Unavailable uses disabled; asynchronous pending maps to Button busy and disabled semantics without replacing its label.

behavior.name: feedbackBoundary
attributes: optional role, aria-live and aria-describedby chosen by target timing
behavior.description: The form provides optional feedback placement only. The target owns localized content, tone, insertion, announcement, focus, recovery and removal.

behavior.name: targetPurchaseLifecycle
behavior.description: Native submission is the required baseline. A capable target may intercept that same valid form and FormData; it owns pending, endpoint, cart mutation, Cart Drawer/count updates, error, retry, focus, announcements, analytics and rollback without creating a parallel submission path.

behavior.name: v1ScopeBoundary
behavior.description: Accelerated checkout and a generic supplementary-field slot are excluded from neutral v1. Selling plans, personalization, uploads, gifts and preorder flows require separately accepted canonical compositions.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: The form and action row wrap from available inline size without viewport breakpoints, reordered DOM, or altered tab order.

properties.name: variantSelector
properties.description: Optional canonical Variant Selector composition; omit it when the product has no meaningful options.

properties.name: quantitySelector
properties.description: Optional canonical Quantity Selector composition; target product policy decides when quantity is fixed or omitted.

properties.name: submitLabel
properties.description: Non-empty localized visible label for the primary purchase submitter.

properties.name: submitDisabled
properties.description: Projects an unavailable resolved selection to the native submitter; targets provide a visible explanation when it is not already evident.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: Projects target-owned asynchronous purchase work to canonical Button busy and disabled semantics.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Optional target-owned localized purchase feedback; Product Form owns placement, not message semantics or lifecycle.

accessibility: Use a real native form and explicit submit button on neutral Web.
Give every submitted child control a stable name and preserve the activated submitter in FormData.
Keep the target-owned merchandise identifier synchronized with current options and disable submission when no purchasable match exists.
Preserve child constraint validation, visible labels, accessible names, keyboard behavior, default values and reset behavior.
Use canonical Button busy semantics for pending work, preserve its visible label, and block repeat activation.
Explain unavailable purchase actions in visible text when option labels or adjacent content do not already communicate the reason.
Let the target choose result insertion, live-region role, focus movement and recovery timing; avoid duplicate announcements across Product Info, Variant Selector and Product Form.
Keep visual order, reading order and tab order aligned across intrinsic wrapping and localization.

web.notes: Native form composition and intrinsic layout need no neutral runtime; product data and purchase lifecycle remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: The Liquid product form is a complete native baseline. One target coordinator atomically refreshes merchandise id, quantity rules and submit availability; the merchant may show or omit Quantity. Optional Ajax may later intercept this same form but is not required for correctness.

react.notes: The shared Exhibit/Studio renderer proves a real form, named canonical children, native validation/FormData/reset, unavailable and pending projection. Framework product features own resolved merchandise and optional request/result state while each child keeps its controlled or uncontrolled contract.
